2113820156992376922.en_summary: Puru Saxena notes GPU rental prices still rising while September AI token dollar spend was flat (+0.2% MoM), but token volume rising as unit prices fell ~47% due to cheaper models, indicating strong demand not weakness, with @vercel usage soaring +1,180% since December.
